access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: The token to authenticate against the API service.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: The unique ID number given to your ad account.

start_date.title: Initial sync date
start_date.description: Starting point for data extraction. Only records created or updated after this date will be synced.

enable_advanced_reports.title: Enable advanced reports
enable_advanced_reports.description: Allows the selection of breakdown reports, such as gender, country, age and device platform. Should be used with caution since the extraction time can increase significantly.

enable_campaign_insights.title: Enable campaign-level insights
enable_campaign_insights.description: Enables the campaign insights stream, which provides insights aggregated at the campaign level instead of the ad level. Produces significantly fewer rows and faster extractions.

performance_granularity.title: Insights granularity
performance_granularity.description: Time granularity for all insight streams (adsinsights and breakdown variants). 'Daily' returns one row per day, 'Monthly' aggregates metrics by calendar month for faster extractions on large date ranges.

ad_insights_report_batch_size.title: Ads Insights: Batch size
ad_insights_report_batch_size.description: The number of reports to request before checking the state and processing them.

report_definition.title: Report definition
report_definition.description: Attribution and lookback settings applied to the Ads Insights reports.

lookback_window.title: Fixed lookback window (days)
lookback_window.description: Fixed window to reprocess data. Facebook freezes insight data 28 days after it was generated.

action_report_time.title: Action report time
action_report_time.description: Determines the report time of action stats. For example, if a person saw the ad on Jan 1st but converted on Jan 2nd, when you select **impression**, you see a conversion on Jan 1st. When you select **conversion**, you see a conversion on Jan 2nd.

action_attribution_windows_view.title: Action attribution windows: Views
action_attribution_windows_view.description: The attribution window for the view actions.

action_attribution_windows_click.title: Action attribution windows: Clicks
action_attribution_windows_click.description: The attribution window for the click actions.

creative_fields_mode.title: Creative fields to extract
creative_fields_mode.description: Controls which fields to extract from creatives. Use 'Basic' for faster extraction with lower rate limits, and only use 'Advanced' if you are sure you need that information, as it incur in higher extraction times.

allowed_values.label: Advanced (all fields, requires more computation from Facebook)

ad_accounts_fields_mode.title: Ad accounts fields to extract
ad_accounts_fields_mode.description: Controls which fields to extract from ad accounts. Use 'Basic' for core fields that work with limited permissions, and 'Extended' if you are sure you need that information, as it requires elevated permissions on all ad accounts.

ads_page_size.title: Ads page size
ads_page_size.description: Number of ads to fetch per API request. Reduce to 50 if you hit 'Please reduce the amount of data' errors on the ads stream.

include_ads_tracking_fields.title: Include ads tracking fields
include_ads_tracking_fields.description: Include tracking_specs, conversion_specs and recommendations in the ads stream. Disable for large accounts that hit Facebook error code 1 ('Please reduce the amount of data you're asking for').

split_creative_on_error.title: Split creative fields on payload-size error
split_creative_on_error.description: If the ads stream still hits Facebook error code 1 ('Please reduce the amount of data you're asking for') after tracking fields are excluded, fetch creative fields in a separate batched request instead of inline. Disable to fall back to the previous behavior for this source.

ads_auto_reduce_page_size.title: Auto-reduce ads page size on payload-size error
ads_auto_reduce_page_size.description: Automatically reduce the ads page size to 50 when Facebook error code 1 ('Please reduce the amount of data you're asking for') persists after tracking and creative fields are already split out. Never goes below 50 due to Facebook pagination constraints.

ads_two_phase_on_error.title: Two-phase ads fetch on payload-size error
ads_two_phase_on_error.description: Last resort for Facebook error code 1 on the ads stream: list ads with id and updated_time only, then batch-fetch the remaining fields by id in small chunks. Activated automatically only when every other mitigation step was insufficient.

include_ad_preview_link.title: Include ad preview link
include_ad_preview_link.description: Include a shareable preview URL (preview_shareable_link) in the ads stream. The URL points to the official Facebook ad preview page (facebook.com/ads/api/preview_iframe.php?...).

preview_ad_format.title: Preview ad format
preview_ad_format.description: Ad placement format used to generate the preview link. Only applies when include_ad_preview_link is enabled.

include_insights_standard_fields.title: Ads Insights: Include additional standard metrics
include_insights_standard_fields.description: Adds extra cost-per, unique, video retention and landing-page metrics to Ads Insights. No special permissions are required, but each report becomes heavier and slower to extract.

include_insights_messaging_fields.title: Ads Insights: Include messaging ads metrics
include_insights_messaging_fields.description: Adds marketing message metrics (sent, delivered, read, button clicks) to Ads Insights. Only enable if the account runs WhatsApp or Messenger message campaigns -- Facebook may reject the request otherwise.

include_insights_commerce_fields.title: Ads Insights: Include commerce metrics
include_insights_commerce_fields.description: Adds catalog segment and converted product metrics to Ads Insights. Only enable if the account has a product catalog with purchase tracking configured -- Facebook may reject the request otherwise.

include_insights_beta_fields.title: Ads Insights: Include beta metrics
include_insights_beta_fields.description: Adds limited-availability metrics such as creative diversity, creative fatigue, advanced reach and auction insights to Ads Insights. Only enable if the account has elevated product access from Facebook -- Facebook may reject the request otherwise.

include_insights_results_fields.title: Ads Insights: Include objective-based results metrics
include_insights_results_fields.description: Adds results, cost per result and objective result metrics to Ads Insights. Only enable if your campaign objectives report these metrics -- Facebook may reject the request otherwise.

insights_excluded_fields.title: Ads Insights: metrics to exclude
insights_excluded_fields.description: Metric names Facebook cannot serve for this ad account. Facebook rejects an entire report when one metric does not apply to the account, so the extraction detects and drops those on its own -- listing them here only makes it permanent and slightly faster. The columns remain in the table and arrive empty.

insights_included_fields.title: Ads Insights: metrics to force
insights_included_fields.description: Metrics the extraction leaves out by default because Facebook does not build reports that contain them (for example total_card_view). List one here only after confirming in the Graph API Explorer that it builds for this ad account; otherwise every insights report of the source fails.

include_insights_attribution_fields.title: Ads Insights: Include SKAN and attribution metrics
include_insights_attribution_fields.description: Adds SKAdNetwork and attribution setting metrics to Ads Insights. Only enable if attribution is configured on the account -- Facebook may reject the request otherwise.

enable_creative_files_stream.title: Enable creative files stream
enable_creative_files_stream.description: Adds a creative_files stream that downloads each ad creative's image and/or thumbnail from Facebook's CDN and uploads the file to a Nekt volume. Extractions become significantly slower and heavier, since every creative's file is downloaded and re-uploaded. Only enable this if you need the creative files stored in a volume.

nekt_volume_to_upload_creative_files.title: Creative Files Volume
nekt_volume_to_upload_creative_files.description: Nekt volume to upload the creative image files to. Required when the creative files stream is enabled.

creative_files_to_upload.title: Creative files to upload
creative_files_to_upload.description: Which creative files to upload. The image is the full-resolution asset, and the thumbnail is Facebook's downscaled preview -- uploading thumbnails only is much faster and lighter.
